data.raw_text:
Kinilala ng Bureau of Fire Protection - Quezon City si Mayor Joy Belmonte dahil sa kanyang suporta sa hanay ng BFP.

Si Mayor Joy at ang buong QC Government ay mahigpit na nakikipagtulungan sa BFP para mabilis na matugunan ang mga sunog, magbigay ng mga kinakailangan nilang kagamitan, at bigyang-kaalaman ang mga mamamayan para makaiwas sa trahedya.

Iniabot ni District Fire Marshal FSSupt Rodrigo Reyes ang Plaque of Appreciation kay Mayor Joy ngayong Lunes.

data.english_translation: The Bureau of Fire Protection - Quezon City acknowledged Mayor Joy Belmonte for his support in the BFP line. Mayor Joy and all QC Government cooperate closely with BFP to meet the fires quickly, give the necessary equipment, and give the people the knowledge to escape the tragedy. District Fire Marshal FSupt Rodgo Reyes extends the Plaque of Appreation to Joyor today Monday.
